PROJECTS.title: An automated 25-tonne hydraulic press for precision load-deflection testing
paras: Australian Compliance Laboratory came to us for a new crush tester: an automated, 25-tonne, push-pull hydraulic press that performs precision load-deflection tests on packaging and products. It is not a machine you can buy off a shelf.

The build uses a LabJack U6 data acquisition device to measure and record everything arriving from the sensors — a primary load cell, a string displacement encoder and nine modular displacement transducers. DAQFactory sits on top, reading the inputs and driving the outputs.

With that in place the lab can control the hydraulic ram, run tests, and measure and record the results. We then programmed custom automation cycles so the machine runs whole test sequences with minimal manual input.

It was also built to grow. As the lab starts testing new products, the system takes new automation cycles and new sensors without being rebuilt — and on price the LabJack and DAQFactory combination came in competitively against other data-acquisition systems, with DAQFactory a one-time purchase rather than a subscription.
PROJECTS.quote: We work with Ocean Controls to provide us with smart, custom machinery that gives us a competitive edge. This kind of machine cannot be purchased off the shelf and suits our business model perfectly.
PROJECTS.partsNote: The LabJack U6 itself, plus terminal boards, probes and DAQFactory licences, all sit in our Data Acquisition and Software categories.

PROJECTS.title: Sewer pump station control for a $40 million reticulated sewerage rollout
paras: Gippsland Water undertook a $40 million project to deliver reticulated sewerage services to approximately 2,700 properties in the lakeside township of Loch Sport, Victoria.

Ocean Controls was contracted on the sewer pump station work — the kind of job where process control, remote monitoring and tank level management all have to survive being installed once and then left alone in the weather for years.

It is representative of a strand of work that runs through our project list: process control programs for water treatment and wastewater treatment plants, and programs for automatic dialling and monitoring of tank levels.
PROJECTS.partsNote: Level monitoring, SMS alarming and protocol gateways from the same catalogue we sell to everyone else.
